instrument: Proposed Local Law 2026-5, 12-month moratorium on large data centers and crypto mining (Town of Potsdam)
summary: Town Board proposed a 12-month moratorium on large-scale data centers and cryptocurrency mining outside the villages of Potsdam and Norwood.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (NorthCountryNow)

next.event: Potsdam public hearing on Local Law 2026-5
